title: Mud on the Rug
lines: The sun is hot. Jon and Bev are on a rug.
A pup hops up. Mud is on its legs.
Mud dots are on top of the rug!
"Not on the rug, pup!" said Jon. Bev nods.
Bev pats the pup, and it hops up.
The pup is on a rug.
Jon and Bev pop the rug in a tub.
Bev and Jon have the bun on a rug.
scoring_note: Decodability forbids apostrophes, so this text is written in uncontracted forms. A child who reads "can't" for "can not", "don't" for "do not" or "let's" for "let us" is reading for meaning and MUST NOT be scored an error.
